description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git behaviors related to untracked files during operations like reset, checkout, rebase, stash, and application of patches. It defines test setups and expectations for handling untracked files in various scenarios.

methods.name: test_setup_reset
methods.description: Initializes a Git repository, creates branches 'stable' and 'work', commits initial files, and checks out the 'work' branch.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution of a Git command sequence involving reset with --hard, --merge, and --keep options, and checks the handling of untracked files.

methods.name: test_setup_checkout_m
methods.description: Sets up a Git repository with commits and branches, with specific files to test 'git checkout -m' behavior in presence of untracked files.

methods.name: test_setup_sequencing
methods.description: Creates a Git history with multiple branches and commits to test rebase and related operations with untracked files.

methods.name: test_expect_failure
methods.description: Defines test cases expected to fail, particularly involving rebase with autostash and stash operations with untracked files.
